overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies spray dried blueberry powder for food manufacturers and ingredient buyers who need steady quality in bulk. Made in India, this powder is processed for fine dispersion, consistent colour, and easy blending in dry and liquid mixes. It is suitable for OEM and private label supply, with custom mesh and packaging available on request.

We are an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter with bulk supply capability. Our 6-step process covers sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch. We support export documentation and offer samples on request, with MOQ starting at 5 Kg. Storage should be in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: What is the MOQ for Blueberry Powder?

faqs.a: The standard mesh size is 80-100 mesh. Custom mesh can be arranged on request.

faqs.q: What packaging options do you offer?
faqs.a: We offer 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5-10 kg bags, and small private-label pouches and jars.

faqs.q: Can you support OEM and private label supply?
faqs.a: Yes. We support OEM and private label supply, along with bulk supply and custom packaging on request.

faqs.q: Do you provide export support and samples?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide export documentation support and samples on request.
